annotationMethod: Agent review of anonymous live DOM captures, rendered screenshots, metadata and local node relationships before any evaluated model output. Candidate inputs were built using the fixed first-eight policy before labels were attached.

violet-netflix.title: t2
violet-netflix.note: The clean h1 names the series. OG artwork and the 1440x658 main backdrop are both representative series imagery. The Netflix ribbon and text-title artwork are not posters; later images and paragraphs belong to trailers/episodes. Both official metadata synopsis versions describe the series, while the description-tag version appends a generic viewing CTA. The page preview video was playing but this remained the anonymous work-detail page, not a full playback route.

hero-apple.title: t2
hero-apple.note: Clean series h1/title-logo alt names the current work. Desktop landscape and responsive mobile portrait are official series artwork. The separate text-logo and WATCHA provider coin are distractors, as are episode cards. The first plot paragraph gives the series premise; subsequent candidate plots describe individual episodes.

bebop-tving.title: t3
bebop-tving.note: Document title and h1 text append episode 1; title image alt gives the clean series title. Official OG artwork remains a series image even though the visible large image nodes are age-gating placeholders. Logo, age placeholders and episode thumbnails do not qualify as representative artwork. Metadata supplies the series synopsis; episode card paragraphs give separate episode plots.

tutu-laftel.title: t3
tutu-laftel.note: Current series is displayed in a detail modal over a populated homepage. Visible modal heading gives the clean series name. OG artwork belongs to the current work while first-eight non-metadata images are unrelated homepage carousel graphics. OG plot and the visible modal synopsis are equivalent apart from the more-view affordance; generic marketing and subsequent episode summaries are excluded.

genre-netflix.title: __none__
genre-netflix.note: Genre landing/index page with category headings, a collage, many catalogue cards and service marketing; no single work detail is open. A work name in a card or a generic anime heading cannot identify a currently open work.

policy-laftel.title: __none__
policy-laftel.note: Official service-terms document, not a work detail. Document/article headings and legal paragraphs are negative candidates. The observed image pool is empty; retain this genuinely empty field but report it separately from nontrivial multiple-choice decisions.
